# How many should you order?

> Free newsvendor calculator for sellers of seasonal, holiday and one-time products. Enter past seasons or a low, likely and high guess, your price, cost and supplier price breaks to get the order quantity that maximises expected profit, the chance of selling out or losing money, and a back-test on your own history.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
